connector.name: smplkit MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Operate smplkit from your agent: feature flags, config, logging, audit, and scheduled jobs.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.smplkit.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.smplkit. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your smplkit API key as a bearer token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Mint one at smplkit.com (sign in with Google or Microsoft, then create an API key).
